segments.sn48.2:1.4: Yato kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ assādañca [samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.) saṃ. ni.2.175] ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti –
segments.sn48.2:1.5: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
